subject: Fluidkey
claim: Bitquery traced at least $1.58 million in unauthorized Fluidkey payouts across six chains over about 36 minutes. Fluidkey took services offline at 18:05 UTC and is working with SEAL 911; the entry point remains unknown.

subject: Wagyu XMR1
claim: About 5.2M XMR1 moved from the token's deployer address to a new wallet and roughly $13.5M was sold into Hyperliquid's order book, crashing the wrapped Monero token about 99.8%. Wagyu's operator says the deployer key sat on a previously deleted server at a compromised hosting provider and promises refunds; the key compromise is his account, not independently verified.

project: Chase, Visa and Mastercard vendor breach
subject: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info
claim: Chase said attackers accessed marketing data held by vendors, and Mastercard confirmed limited email exposure in one benefit program. Visa said a provider in Asia Pacific was affected but its own systems and payment data were not; the providers and total number of people affected have not been confirmed.

claim: Binance’s preliminary report attributes the October 29 theft of roughly $6.3 billion to social engineering, compromised employee devices and unauthorized access to wallet signing. In its latest update Binance said asset recovery and legal proceedings remain ongoing, without disclosing a recovered total.

subject: Alleged hosting intrusion and Trubank exposure
claim: VECERT Analyzer relayed an unverified claim of access to 1,331 databases at an unnamed multi-tenant hosting provider and to a system attributed to Trubank. The provider’s identity, any unauthorized access, and the number of people affected have not been established.

posts.note: Summarizes an unverified claim involving an unnamed hosting provider and a system attributed to Trubank.

subject: K3 Capital
claim: K3 Capital’s post-mortem attributes the November 18 sBOLD vault drain of about 3.43 million BOLD to a flaw in the vault’s handling of collateral swaps. The vault was paused, and K3 says it is pursuing partial recovery; losses were confined to sBOLD rather than Liquity V2.

subject: European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services
claim: The European Commission said it took several internal applications offline after an AI-assisted campaign detected in October, and said most had been restored. It reported finding no evidence of a breach affecting staff as a whole, but the investigation is ongoing.
